verdict.rationale: Docs show a built-in AI palette (cmd-j) that can summarize meeting notes, list action items, answer custom prompts, and 'chat' with filtered/specific notes grounded in the user's own content, with model choice (GPT-4o/Claude 3.5). Data-scoping control is shown via search filters before chatting with a subset of notes, and E2E encryption is claimed for note content, though community evidence notes files/images are excluded from encryption. Missing for 10: independent hands-on review of AI answer quality/grounding, explicit UI controls for restricting AI's data access beyond search filters, and no clarification on how E2E encryption interacts with cloud-based AI processing.
